scenarios.name: Hero Section and Value Proposition
scenarios.description: Tests the hero section displays a clear value proposition with headline, description, and prominent CTA buttons that guide users to registration

steps.description: Load the homepage at the root URL (/)
steps.context: User arrives at the application for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section is prominently displayed with a large headline
steps.context: Hero section should be the first visible content after navigation

steps.description: Confirm the headline and subheadline clearly communicate URL shortening and analytics value
Check for a prominent 'Get Started' or 'Sign Up' button
steps.context: Button should be visually distinct and clickable

steps.description: Check for a secondary action like 'Learn More'
steps.context: Secondary CTA provides alternative user path

test_cases.expected: Component renders without errors

test_cases.input: Check for h1 element with headline text
test_cases.expected: Headline element exists with text about URL shortening (e.g., 'Shorten URLs, Track Every Click')
Subheadline element exists explaining the service value
Button with text 'Get Started' or 'Sign Up' is rendered and has correct styling
Navigation to /register page is triggered
Heading hierarchy is correct (h1), sufficient color contrast, focusable CTA

scenarios.name: Navigation and Routing
scenarios.description: Tests that navigation bar displays correctly with login/register links and routes work properly for unauthenticated users

steps.description: Navigate to the root URL (/)
Check that the navigation bar is displayed at the top of the page
steps.context: Navbar should contain logo and navigation links

steps.description: Check for a Login button/link in the navigation
steps.context: Login should be visible for unauthenticated users

steps.description: Click the Login button and verify navigation
Check for a Register/Sign Up button in the navigation
steps.context: Registration should be visible for unauthenticated users

steps.description: Click the Register button and verify navigation

test_cases.input: Render Home page with Router context
test_cases.expected: Navbar component is rendered

test_cases.input: Check for Login link/button in navbar
test_cases.expected: Login link exists with href='/login' or onClick handler

test_cases.input: Check for Register link/button in navbar
test_cases.expected: Register link exists with href='/register' or onClick handler
Router navigates to /login
Router navigates to /register
Clicking logo navigates to / (homepage)
Navigation is keyboard accessible with proper ARIA labels

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Tests that the features section displays at least 3 feature cards with icons, titles, and descriptions highlighting URL shortening, analytics, and sharing capabilities

steps.description: Load the homepage and scroll to features section
steps.context: Features section should be visible below the hero

steps.description: Check that a dedicated features section is present
steps.context: Section should have clear heading or visual separation

steps.description: Verify at least 3 feature cards are displayed
Check for a card describing URL shortening capability
Check for a card describing click analytics
Each card should have icon, title, and description
steps.context: Consistent card format per UI requirements

test_cases.expected: Component renders without errors
At least 3 feature cards are rendered

test_cases.input: Check for URL Shortening feature card
test_cases.expected: Card with title containing 'URL' or 'Shorten' exists
Card with title containing 'Analytics' or 'Track' exists
Card mentioning location tracking or GeoIP exists
Each feature card contains an icon element (svg or img)
Each feature card contains a heading (h2, h3, or h4)
Each feature card contains descriptive text paragraph
Proper heading hierarchy, alt text for icons, readable contrast

scenarios.name: How It Works Section
scenarios.description: Tests that the 'How It Works' section displays a clear step-by-step explanation of the user journey from signup to tracking analytics

steps.description: Load the homepage and scroll to How It Works section
steps.context: Section should be visible after features section

steps.description: Check that a How It Works section is present
Check that 3 steps are displayed
Each step should be clearly numbered or sequenced
steps.context: Visual ordering helps users understand flow

steps.description: Steps should cover: signup, shortening, tracking
steps.context: Complete user journey must be explained

test_cases.expected: Component renders without errors
Heading with text 'How It Works' or similar exists
Exactly 3 steps are rendered
Each step has a number indicator (1, 2, 3) or step label
Step 1 mentions signup or account creation
Step 2 mentions URL shortening or pasting URL
Step 3 mentions sharing or analytics tracking
Steps are visually connected or flow logically (arrows, lines, or layout)

scenarios.name: Theme Switching
scenarios.description: Tests that theme toggle functionality works correctly on the homepage, switching between light/dark modes and persisting preference

steps.description: Navigate to homepage with default theme
steps.context: Theme should match system preference or stored preference

steps.description: Find the theme toggle button in the UI
steps.context: Toggle should be in navbar per existing patterns

steps.description: Click the toggle to switch theme
Check that page styling reflects new theme
Reload page and check theme persists

test_cases.expected: ThemeToggle component is rendered in navbar
Document has data-theme attribute or theme class applied
Theme context value changes

test_cases.input: Verify DOM theme attribute after toggle
test_cases.expected: data-theme attribute changes to reflect new theme
Theme preference is saved to localStorage
Previously selected theme is applied on load
All available themes (light, dark, cyberpunk, etc.) can be selected

test_cases.input: Verify homepage content visible in all themes
test_cases.expected: All sections maintain readability and contrast in each theme

steps.description: View homepage at 1920px or 1440px width
steps.context: Full desktop layout should be visible

steps.description: Check that features are in grid, navbar is expanded
Change viewport to 768px width
Check layout adapts appropriately
steps.context: May show hamburger menu or adjusted grid

steps.description: Change viewport to 375px width
Check that all content is accessible, no horizontal scroll
Check hamburger menu works on mobile
steps.context: Navigation should be accessible via mobile menu

test_cases.expected: All sections render in full desktop layout
Layout adjusts for tablet, content remains readable
Layout is single column, no horizontal overflow

test_cases.input: Check feature cards at mobile width
test_cases.expected: Feature cards stack vertically on mobile
Hamburger menu icon is visible, navigation is collapsed
Mobile menu opens with Login/Register links
CTA buttons are full-width or appropriately sized for touch

test_cases.input: Check horizontal scroll at all breakpoints
test_cases.expected: No horizontal scrollbar appears at any viewport width
All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch target
